title: Practice 2: The family of свет (освети́ть, свеча)

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Soon the sky will become bright.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: It's getting light. Morning is coming.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: свети́ло — heavenly body, celestial body, lamp; светя́щийся — luminous, lambent, lucent; свети́льник — lamp, light fixture; света́ть — (impersonal) to dawn.
**осветилось** — освети́ться (perfective): to light up, to brighten. Wiktionary: освети́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Ahead, a clearing among the trees appeared.
exercises.why: **просвет** — просве́т: clear space, ray of light (in the clouds); ray of hope; (on shoulder strap) space; (engineering) gap.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Pockets of blue sky are beginning to appear.
exercises.why: **просветы** — просве́т: clear space, ray of light (in the clouds); ray of hope; (on shoulder strap) space; (engineering) gap.

exercises.q: The world is lit by the sun.
exercises.why: **освещается** — освеща́ться (imperfective): to light up, to brighten. Wiktionary: освеща́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: clear space, ray of light (in the clouds)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: о́тсвет — reflection, reflected light, glow, gleam; освети́ться — to light up, to brighten; светово́й — (relational) light; просве́т — clear space, ray of light (in the clouds).

exercises.why: **освещается** — освеща́ться (imperfective): to light up, to brighten. Wiktionary: освеща́ть + -ся.
